High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:144270
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 28170 of 2023

Applicant :- Babita
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Mahendra Bahadur Singh,Shashank Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Ms. Vijeta Singh, Advocate holding brief of Sri Mahendra Bahadur Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr. S.B. Maurya, learned AGA-I for the State.
2.

The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 488 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304B, 323, 506, 120B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Baldeo, District Mathura during pendency of the trial.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and nine others including her son i.e.
husband of the deceased and according to the FIR marriage of the son of the applicant was performed with the deceased on 10.07.2019 and after marriage applicant and her family members tortured the deceased for the motorcycle, golden ring and Rs. 1 lakh and on 27.06.2022 informant received an information that applicant and her family members committed the murder of his sister i.e. deceased.

Babita vs State Of U.P. on 19 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3055055/
1 4.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that entire allegation of demand of dowry and harassment made against the applicant is totally false and baseless and only being mother-in-law of the deceased she has been made accused in the present matter.

She further submits that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and she was not having any concern with the family affairs of the deceased and actually some dispute arose between husband and wife and due to the dispute arose between them, the wife committed suicide.
5. She further submits that post mortem report of the deceased also suggests that deceased died due to hanging and her hyoid bone was found intact.
She further submits that applicant is a lady and she is in jail since 19.01.2023 i.e. for last six months.

6. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her and as per autopsy report deceased died due to hanging.
7. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

8. Considering the fact that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her either in the FIR or in the statement of witness and post mortem report suggests that deceased died due to hanging, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
9. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

10. Let the applicant -Babita be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
11. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

12. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
